ratings_why.fun: Over a 7 because the shop turns into a menu of other tribes' texts, so every refresh is a real choice, and wearing payoff cards (a Changeling in a Bettie or Nursemaid guise) opens combos the designer never listed.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because no tribe today is other tribes: a Changeling counts as an Ooze or Bird for their cards and bonuses, and Grandfer can be three at once, which plays unlike any copy effect in Battlegrounds.

verdict_why: The engine is great as it is, but three cards need one-line rules fixes so players can tell what counts as a wear and when.

points.text: Bettie's "for each guise they put on" reads two ways: each Changeling's own wears, or all wears together. The tier note means all together, so say "for each guise your Changelings put on this turn".

Say whether a Stock wearing under Wicker Moll or the Alder Whittler counts as "a Changeling you own wears a unit" for the Nursemaid, Pedlar and Bettie, and whether Moll's Stocks wear in the shop or when bought.
The Hoverfly Guest and Penny Second put on a guise at Start of Combat. Say whether the worn enemy's own Start of Combat text then fires for the Changeling.
Inside-Out Tod's sell wears have no once-a-turn cap, so buy-and-sell turns become a wear engine for Bettie and the Nursemaid. That's a great Johnny line; name it as a build so players find it.
Give Pip Unlike one worked example in the risks or tooltip, such as a mirrored Pass going to your leftmost unit, so the mirror rules read at a glance.

standouts.why: Grandfer Acorn wearing three texts from three tribes is the tribe's best toy: an Ooze, a Bog unit and a Hunter at once.
Tam Twice copying your own carry, or your own Bettie or Glamour-Weaver, makes two of your best card without a triple.
Inside-Out Tod turns selling into growth and lets you keep the text of a golden you outgrew.

weakest.why: The Porter is a plain passive that may become a must-have just to keep early Guise units useful.
The Leaf-Gold Pedlar is plain economy with no interaction beyond wearing.
The Cradle Foundling is only the keyword; fine as a seed but nothing to play around.

flags.note: Uncapped sell-wears plus Bettie and the Nursemaid; bounded by gold, but worth testing.
Golden Lady with Grandfer gives three texts at x4 numbers on one body.
Wiping up to four enemy texts can decide a fight at Start of Combat.
"Each guise they put on" can be read per Changeling or for all together.
Unclear whether Stock wears trigger the wear payoffs, and when Moll's Stocks wear.
Unclear whether a guise taken at Start of Combat fires its own Start of Combat text.
